software: the paper says 'The ORCA 3.0.1 software package was used for all DFT computations' (p.4, l.383); the CASSCF/NEVPT2 paragraph (l.423-433) names no program. Row is 'cyclooctatetraene tub minimum' (D2d) but says 'the lowest triplet at this geometry is 17.4 kcal/mol above the singlet'. Table I footnote a (p.2, attached to the D8h column entry 18.3) reads 'At the CASSCF/3-21G optimized D8h geometry for the singlet, the lowest triplet lies 17.4 kcal/mol higher' - it belongs to the bond-shift TS (D8h), not the tub minimum. Also the row folds the D4h ring-inversion TS and D8h bond-shift TS into a compound_name naming only the tub minimum.

Paper uses two production active spaces, one per excited state (Table 3, p.7): state 1 CASSCF (3,4) [4b1u 4b2g 5b1u 5b2g], state 2 CASSCF (1,3) [4b2g 5b1u 5b2g] ('four MOs and three electrons for transition 1 and three MOs and one electron for transition 2'). compound_name 'acetylene + ozone reaction system' stands for several stationary points (TS0, TS1, M1, at CAS(6,6) and CAS(8,8) geometries) rather than one species; electronic_structure_description concatenates them. Row 'AsF2 neutral/cation/anion redox manifold' covers three species (AsF2, AsF2+, AsF2-) whose full-valence active spaces differ in electron count (18/19/20 in 12 orbitals). Thesis ch. on O3 (p.126-127): the (18,12) SA-CASSCF/cc-pVQZ space is from the PREVIOUS study that supplied the geometries ('The geometries used in this study were obtained in a previous study from optimizations using state-averaged CASSCF(18,12)/cc-pVQZ'). The reference spaces this work's CEEIS/CEEMBE calculations actually use are CASSCF(2,2) (4b1, 2b2) and CASSCF(6,4) (6a1, 1a2, 4b1, 2b2), the latter preferred, with 5b1 and 7a1 placed in the virtual space in all reported calculations. nel/norb 18/12 is likely not the production space. Consider (6,4), or a split by reference scheme.

Siegbahn 1984 Faraday Symp. is a review; the CCl and ClF (row -e) calculations are cited from ref 19 and the paper never states any (nel,norb) for them. nel 11/14 and norb '8;13' are derived by shell counting ('full-valence CASSCF including only the s and p shells' then 'including also the 3d shell of chlorine'). norb is a packed non-integer; if kept, the production space is the one with Cl 3d (13 by count), but the counts are inferred rather than stated, so clearing nel/norb may be the policy-correct outcome. Same applies to W2069024422-e.

ClF: as for -d, no active space is stated ('Essentially the same sequence of results as for CCl was also obtained for ClF'); nel=14 and norb='8;13' are shell-count inferences, results come from cited ref 19, and norb is packed. Needs a human decision (clear or set norb 13 with an inference note).
